blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Taxes can sound difficult, but in English they follow simple patterns. A tax is money you pay to the government. Every company pays taxes, and there are rules for this.

In this lesson you learn five simple words: tax, government, company, money and rule. You practise them in short sentences with the verb to be — am, is, are.

Go slowly — one step at a time. Taxes become easier with practice. You can do it!

items.q: What is a tax?
options: Money you pay to the government
items.why: "A tax is money you pay to the government."

items.q: How many new words does the lesson teach?
items.why: "you learn five simple words": tax, government, company, money, rule.

items.q: Which verb do you practise in this lesson?
items.why: "You practise them... with the verb to be — am, is, are."

items.q: The text suggests that taxes are…
items.why: Inferência: "Taxes become easier with practice" — a mensagem é positiva, não que sejam impossíveis.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with the idea that…
options: you should go slowly, one step at a time
taxes are too hard, so you should give up
items.why: Inferência: o texto encoraja ("You can do it!"), então discordaria de "desista".

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie explicar para um novo colega o que são impostos. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! Welcome to the team. My name is Sophie. I am happy you are here. Today I explain the tax words. They are easy — I go slowly, one step at a time.

First, a tax is money. The company pays this money to the government. The government has rules, and we follow the rules. That is all. It is very simple.

Now, look at this form. The tax number is here, at the top. It must be correct before we send the form. If the number is wrong, we fix it. It is not a big problem — we check it together, and then it is fine.

Every month we work with the accounting team. They are very kind, and they are ready to help. You are not alone here. If you have a question, you ask me. My desk is next to yours.

Remember: taxes are just one more part of our routine. They are not scary. One small step at a time, and it becomes easy with practice. You are ready for this, and I am happy to help. Let's start now!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is Sophie's name and role in this scene?
options: A colleague who explains the tax words
items.why: "My name is Sophie. Today I explain the tax words."

items.q: Who does the company pay the money to?
items.why: "The company pays this money to the government."

items.q: What must be correct before they send the form?
items.why: "The tax number is here. It must be correct before we send the form."

items.q: What does Sophie mean by "You are not alone here"?
options: There are too many people in the office
The new colleague works from home
The new colleague can get help from the team
items.why: Inferência: ela oferece ajuda ("you ask me... I am happy to help") — a pessoa tem apoio.

items.q: How would you best describe Sophie's tone?
items.why: Inferência: "It is not a problem", "I am happy to help", "You are ready" — tom gentil e encorajador.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The company pays a tax every month." A tax is…
options: money you pay to the government
items.why: Tax = imposto: dinheiro que se paga ao governo.

items.q: "The government makes the rules." The government is…
options: the people who run the country
items.why: Government = governo: quem administra o país.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Our ___ is small, but we pay all our taxes on time."
items.why: Company = empresa: aquilo que paga os impostos.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We count the ___ before we send it to the government."
items.why: Money = dinheiro: o que se conta antes de enviar.

items.q: "We follow this rule every year." A rule is…
items.why: Rule = regra: algo que você deve seguir.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The manager has to sign off on the tax form." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval.

items.q: "We fill in the form with the tax number." To fill in means to…
items.why: Fill in = preencher (escrever as informações no formulário).

items.q: "Please check on the money before we pay." To check on means to…
options: look at it to be sure
items.why: Check on = verificar, dar uma olhada para ter certeza.

items.q: "The new colleague is starting to pick up the tax words." To pick up means to…
items.why: Pick up = aprender aos poucos, pegar o jeito.

items.q: "Let's go over the rules together." To go over means to…
options: review or look at them again
items.why: Go over = revisar, passar de novo por algo.
